$schema_note: Source-consumer map for FORMAT_CONVERSION event contract. This is a Stage A draft — no real producer or integration exists.

sources.description: Store Operations ERP or equivalent system that tracks physical store remodeling projects
sources.evidence: No producer, connector, or ingestion pipeline for store conversion events exists in the repository. Confirmed by rg search across modules/, models/, solver/, pipelines/ — zero hits for format_conversion or brownfield in production code.
sources.stage_b_requirement: H04 must identify the actual ERP system, data export format, and access authorization.

sources.description: Finance/Real Estate system providing remodeling capex, asset depreciation, salvage values, and disposal costs
sources.evidence: simulator.py (modules/site_economics/domain/simulator.py) only models greenfield capex via SimulationInput.custom_equipment_capex and custom_fitout_capex. No brownfield remodeling, residual value, or disposal cost paths exist.
sources.stage_b_requirement: H04 must provide actual financial parameters, depreciation schedules, and cost breakdown methodology.

sources.description: Site Economics domain model providing ramp curves and revenue baselines
sources.evidence: RampCurveSpec exists in modules/site_economics/domain/formats.py for greenfield stores. TargetFormatRegistry registers ODAY_G2, ODAY_G3_COMPACT, ODAY_FLAGSHIP. No conversion-specific ramp exists.
sources.stage_b_requirement: Determine whether conversion ramp differs from greenfield ramp. If yes, define ConversionRampCurveSpec and register per format transition pair.

sources.description: PostgreSQL core.stores and SQLite stores tables
sources.evidence: core.stores in 000001_baseline_canonical_schema.sql and stores in 000004_durable_product_domain.sql both have store_format_code as static column. No conversion history or event log table.
sources.stage_b_requirement: New migration to create core.store_format_conversions table per contract in ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS §4.2.

consumers.evidence: SimulationInput only models new-store greenfield projections. No ConversionSimulationInput or brownfield cash flow path exists.
consumers.stage_b_action: Extend simulator.py with ConversionSimulationInput: downtime loss = daily_baseline × downtime_days; net capex = remodeling_capex - residual_value + disposal_cost; apply conversion ramp curve.
acceptance_tests: Brownfield conversion first-year net cash flow reflects downtime revenue loss and is worse than greenfield zero-downtime baseline
Residual value increase causes proportional net capex decrease
Event replay with same event_id does not duplicate cost entries

consumers.evidence: SiteScoreFeatureInput and scoring logic in modules/sitescore/domain/scoring.py have no brand_transfer or format_conversion fields. SiteScore currently scores greenfield candidates only.
consumers.stage_b_action: TBD — depends on whether SiteScore should evaluate existing-store conversion ROI or only greenfield site selection. Requires product decision.

consumers.evidence: No store_format_conversions table in any migration (000001–000013). Only static store_format_code column exists.
consumers.stage_b_action: Create migration for core.store_format_conversions per ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS §4.2 schema spec. Align SQLite 000004 equivalent.
acceptance_tests: Migration runs cleanly on both PostgreSQL and SQLite schemas
Unique constraint on event_id prevents duplicate inserts

consumers.evidence: set_valued_requirements.json records FORMAT_CONVERSION as absent/BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE with formal_handback_ref to ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS. check_requirement_members.py validates this state.
consumers.stage_b_action: Update FORMAT_CONVERSION status from absent/BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE to satisfied/VERIFIED only after real producer, migration, and simulator integration are completed and tested.
acceptance_tests: check_requirement_members.py passes in both Stage A (BLOCKED) and Stage B (VERIFIED) states

stage_b_entry_conditions: H04 human input provides real conversion events, financial parameters, and operational playbook
Cross-source/consumer contract review completed (event schema, persistence migration, simulator input)
Store Operations formally approves brownfield conversion playbook with cost schedules and downtime parameters
Schema migration for core.store_format_conversions created and reviewed
